content.heroTitle: English B1 Vocabulary: Mastering the 2500 Essential Words
content.heroQuestion: How many words are in English B1?
content.heroAnswer: To reach B1 proficiency, you need approximately 2500 words. However, simply knowing the list is not enough; you need to master the usage and pronunciation.
introParagraphs: English B1 vocabulary practice helps you develop stronger communication skills and move beyond basic conversations. At this intermediate stage, you learn to express opinions, describe experiences, and handle everyday challenges more independently.

With intermediate English vocabulary, you expand your ability to understand texts, participate in discussions, and write clear messages. A structured B1 English word list supports steady progress and practical language use.

levelExplanation.heading: What Does B1 Level Mean?
levelExplanation.paragraph: The B1 level marks the transition to independent language use. When you learn English vocabulary B1 level, you can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar topics and manage most situations while traveling or working.
bullets: You can describe experiences, events, and goals in detail.
You can explain reasons and give simple arguments.
You can write connected texts on familiar subjects.
